evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C and C++ API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h
rationale: Adjusts the kernel logging callback API to reflect the singleton nature of the underlying logger. Replacing per-connection handles with a global callback is an internal API simplification that clarifies caller expectations and unblocks #34374, though it remains a deferrable design adjustment.
